## About
Calaveras Nursery is a family owned and operated nursery in the Sunol Valley, a fairly short drive from just about anywhere in the greater Bay Area.
We grow many different plants ourselves, and we work with a huge network of growers we've dealt with over the years. That's how we bring you one of the most massive selections of landscape plants around.
We've sold to landscapers, builders, golf courses, cities, schools and the general public. Quality, service and low prices are how we run the nursery, and it shows in our 4.5 rating from 54 Google reviews.

## Services
- Landscape plants: One of the finest selections of landscape plants, for the general public and landscapers alike.
- Trees and shrubs: A reviewer noted we carry a lot of different kinds of trees and shrubs.
- Special orders: If we don't have a tree or plant at the nursery, one reviewer says we'll special order it and call when it arrives.

## FAQ
Q: Are you open to the public?
A: Yes. We're plant growers and brokers, and we sell to homeowners as well as landscapers.

Q: How do I find your entrance?
A: If you're coming from the north and turn left under the freeway overpass, we are not the first nursery you see. Drive 300 ft further down Calaveras Road and you'll come to our entrance.

Q: What's the fastest way to reach you?
A: Give us a call during business hours at 925-862-2286.

Q: Do you ever close early?
A: We may close early during inclement weather, so it's a good idea to call ahead on a stormy day.
